sourceQuote:
Dunn County Registered Write-In Candidates by Office

                       General Election - November 3, 2026

              Office                                         Name
                                                        Ieshuh Griffin
                                                     Jamie Jo Carothers
                                                        David D. King
Governor of the State of Wisconsin                   Chad Muellenberg
                                                        Mary Morgan
                                                        Mark Grimek
                                                      Brayden Donnelly
       Dunn County Sheriff                            Chad Weinberger
limits: Official county-published November3 list proves these seven names are listed as registered gubernatorial write-ins. It does not provide parties, running mates, individual registration dates or a dated final statewide write-in certification.
This is separate from the 128 regular race fields and 260 printed tickets in the WEC August25 general-election roster. That printed-nominee comparison is complete independently of this supplement.
The source contains only Governor and Dunn County Sheriff. It does not establish absence of registered write-ins for other offices or counties.
